Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus): Server group restart now generally available

Body.Content:
When you use the server group restart feature, all nodes in your Hyperscale (Citus) server group are restarted. You will be given a notification in advance of any database downtime that the server group restart will cause. The Hyperscale (Citus) server group restart capability is currently available in the Azure portal.

Learn more.
